vm.runtime_image_note: Built locally by `make -C peer-node opencode-runtime-vm`; the ID records the dev-host validation build and is not portable.

notes: The package checksum is from the signed v0.1.7 release's openshell-checksums-sha256.txt.
The image digests are the multi-architecture index digests; the host architecture manifest is selected at pull time.
The VM runtime image is a local build; a host rebuild produces a new image ID and must be recorded before deployment.
